messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High error rate detected for Avalon Labs on dedicated-cluster-43. 5xx rate > 8% and p95 latency spiking > 4s. Pager routed to on-call. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.local/alert/AV-9876
anna-m (oncall): acked. pulling up dashboards now. any customer impact reported?
leah-c (acct-csm): getting pinged by their lead infra — intermittent timeouts, some requests getting 504s. They say recent deploy was 02:15 UTC but unsure.
ryan-s (sre): checking cluster metrics: GPU util at 98% on pool g4-43, queue length on router up ~1200, KV eviction rate increased. possible noisy tenant or batch job.
priya (eng-runtime): can you run hot-queues view on that pool? i'll check model-level latencies.
tom-c (platform): i'm looking at autoscaler. No recent scale events; reserved capacity is pinned. there is a burst capacity setting but it hasn't kicked. Might be backpressure on frontend routing.
anna-m (oncall): running commands:
```
# check recent tail of errors
redwoodctl metrics query --cluster dedicated-cluster-43 --metric request_5xx --window 15m
redwoodctl inspect pool g4-43 --tail 200
```

anna-m (oncall): results: 5xx concentrated on node g4-43-7 and g4-43-9, runtime logs show repeated OOM-related kv evictions + connection resets.
ryan-s (sre): looks like noisy tenant. which tenant id?
anna-m (oncall): tenant id 8634 (internal: avalon-prod is 8634) — but eviction logs show large KV writes from tenant 8679 (unknown). routing table shows requests from 8679 spiking on same nodes.
priya (eng-runtime): that's the noisy neighbor signature. KV working set thrashing / cache evictions + kernel-level latency. we can try two mitigations: 1) throttle tenant 8679 at edge 2) move some of avalon traffic to spare nodes (spillover) 3) enable burst capacity if available. which should we do first?
anna-m (oncall): do throttle first, quick and reversible. tom, can you throttle 8679 at the gateway? runbook step 4.2 says use rate-limiter.
tom-c (platform): on it.
```
# throttle tenant
redwoodctl gateway throttle --tenant 8679 --rate 10rps --reason "noisy neighbor causing evictions"
```

deploy-bot: Throttle command applied by tom-c at 3467900100.
priya (eng-runtime): adding a temporary KV eviction guard on g4-43 nodes: set low-priority eviction threshold to reduce tail latency.
anna-m (oncall): toggled evict-guard flag. monitoring metrics.
ryan-s (sre): after throttle + guard: 5xx dropped from 8.4% -> 1.6% in 3m, queue length down to ~250, p95 latency down to 380ms. nice.
leah-c (acct-csm): telling Avalon support the mitigation — they reported fewer timeouts already. sending status update.
leah-c (acct-csm): "We've applied a mitigation and are monitoring; will follow up if degraded again."
anna-m (oncall): next steps: keep throttle for 20 min, let autoscaler evaluate. if noise returns, plan is to evict tenant 8679 to coldpool and open a follow-up with infra to investigate their workload.
priya (eng-runtime): opened issue infra#AV-1254 to investigate tenant 8679 workload pattern + recommend quotas.
ryan-s (sre): I'll schedule a rolling drain of g4-43-9 if we see residual KV pressure.
tom-c (platform): autoscaler policy tweak queued: increase burst threshold from 0.15 -> 0.25 for this pool while we monitor. manual bump will be available if metrics don't stabilize.
anna-m (oncall): handing off to night on-call @ryan-s in 40m. I'll stay for 10m to ensure stability.
ryan-s (sre): taking over monitoring. set a pager for 5xx > 3% or queue > 600.
incident-bot: NOTE: Pager rules updated by ryan-s at 3467901200.
anna-m (oncall): status update to #customer-avalon: "We identified a noisy tenant, throttled offending tenant 8679, applied KV guard, and adjusted autoscaler. Error rates returned to near baseline. SRE will continue monitoring."
leah-c (acct-csm): Avalon responded: "Thanks — we saw a big improvement. Please keep us posted. We'll await postmortem."
priya (eng-runtime): leaving a snippet from runtime logs for postmortem:
```
[2026-06-18T02:45:01Z] node=g4-43-7 tenant=8679 kv_write_size=24MB eviction=high latency_ms=1200
[2026-06-18T02:45:02Z] node=g4-43-7 tenant=8634 req_id=... err=504 connection_reset
```

anna-m (oncall): final note: creating incident ticket INC-20260618-AV-8679 for follow-up, tagging platform/eng-runtime/sales. Closing thread after handoff.
ryan-s (sre): acknowledged. I'll run a full diagnostic tomorrow and correlate with tenant 8679 deploys.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260618-AV-8679 created at 3467902500.
anna-m (oncall): resolved for now, keeping watch. :)
